frame: x = patient left, y = superior, z = anterior; origin = centroid of the mandible surface
setting: human x3.5, k 0.010/day, remodelling off, graded early factor 0.37
voxel_rule: each 0.2 mm voxel holds 2x2x2 lattice sites of 0.1 mm; inside the socket if at least 4 of its 8 sites are socket sites (else 255); drawn if at least 40 % of its socket sites hold a cell or granule (else 0), as the most frequent such code, ties to new bone > granule > stem cell > fibroblast > chondrocyte; the voxels show about 4-8 points more new bone than the 0.1 mm lattice, series.json has the exact values

surface_strain.vertices: the vertices of mandible.glb, in their order
surface_strain.quantity: largest absolute principal strain of the nearest bone element of the jaw model, one load case per row

new_in_v2: meshes.bridge: the zirconia bridge 34-33-32-31-41-42-43, same frame as the jaw
surface_strain: per-vertex strain on mandible.glb for each load case
runs: further simulations; each has frames per socket (same origin and dims as sockets[]) and its own series file; the first entry is the version-1 simulation
runs[].same_cells_as: the run gives cell for cell the same healing as that run, so it reuses its frames
changes_in_2_1: runs ovate_cap and ovate_cap_swapped: ovate pontics as placed into fresh sockets, occupying the socket mouth down to the crest with no pressure; the clot forms against them and they move with the bridge
meshes.bridge_ovate: the bridge with those ovate pontics, same frame as the jaw
runs ovate05*, ovate10*: relabelled; pressing a pontic 0.5-1 mm into a fresh socket is not clinical practice, these are upper bounds
runs[].clinical: true for the clinically placed variants, false for the upper bounds
changes_in_2_2: meshes.implants: the two immediate implants (32: 3.0 mm wide, 9.0 mm long; 33: 3.75 mm wide, 16.6 mm long; platform at the crest, tip 3 mm beyond the socket apex), same frame as the jaw
meshes.crowns: single crowns on the two implants (scenario without bridge)

runs implants_unloaded, implants_bridge, implants_crowns (runs[].implants = true): the frames show the gap between implant and socket wall (implant voxels are 255); their series give the gap and bone_implant_contact (no virtual core: the implant fills it)
surface_strain: rows appended for the loaded implant cases from month 3 (bridge on teeth and implants; single crowns on the implants)
